sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "fees"."orderslink" AS e, AVG((CAST(("fees"."rebrate" - "fees"."feerate") AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate")) AS m1 FROM "fees" GROUP BY "fees"."orderslink"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m1" > "s4"."v") SELECT AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5"

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "fees"."orderslink" AS e, "orders"."dealedge" AS g, AVG(("fees"."feerate" - "fees"."rebrate")) AS m1 FROM "fees" JOIN "orders" ON "orders"."recordvault" = "fees"."orderslink"  GROUP BY "fees"."orderslink", "orders"."dealedge"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"), "s5" AS (SELECT AVG("s4"."m2") AS v FROM "s4") SELECT "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s4"."m2" AS REAL) / "s5"."v") AS m3 FROM "s4" JOIN "s5" ON "s5"."v" IS NOT NULL
